subject.title: [Feishu] 飞书群多机器人身份混乱问题

question: Should Feishu group sessions become account/app-scoped, and what migration or compatibility contract should existing Feishu group sessions use?
rationale: The source-level fix direction is clear, but changing a durable channel session key affects persisted transcripts, bindings, last-route state, message delivery identity, and security boundaries, so automation should not choose the permanent contract alone.

options.title: Account-scope Feishu group sessions
options.body: Make the Feishu group conversation/session identity include a stable account/app component and ship the matching doctor migration, docs, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Keep shared group sessions with documented limits
options.body: Document that same-agent multi-account Feishu bots in one group share context unless routed to distinct agents or another explicit isolation mode.

options.title: Add an opt-in isolation mode first
options.body: Preserve current default keys and add a narrow Feishu-owned group isolation option while maintainers gather upgrade proof for a future default change.

recommendation.title: Account-scope Feishu group sessions
recommendation.body: Make the Feishu group conversation/session identity include a stable account/app component and ship the matching doctor migration, docs, and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The package and manifest identify this handle as the Feishu/Lark plugin ownership signal, and the decision is Feishu-specific.
